item: Jumbo Band — Bring Me to Life (Evanescence)
qc: Both 5769 frames (identical to source), video 230.760s / audio 230.782s, -13.6 LUFS preserved from the source measurement. ffmpeg logs clean. Audio decodes to 229.5s falling -18 -> -37 -> -44 dB (fades, does not cut). Tail contact sheet confirms additive overlay: picture fades under the logo, final frame is logo on near-black.
fade: Card starts 226.84s = video length minus the card's own 3.92s, so its last frame lands on the last frame of picture and it enters 2.1s after the music stops (224.72s), over the crowd tail.
thumbnail: /Volumes/BOTTB/Renders/Thumbnails/BringMeToLife/jumbo-band-bring-me-to-life-youtube.jpg — Dean composed it from a frame at 1:29.5 into the song. His PNG was 2.71 MB and YouTube caps thumbnails at 2 MB, so it would have been REJECTED on upload; converted to JPEG q92 = 0.36 MB, still 1920x1080, no visible artefacts on logo or type.
title_proposed: Evanescence - Bring Me to Life (Live Cover) - Jumbo Interactive - BoTTB Brisbane 2026 (85 chars). The exact-precedent wording matching The Chain was 104 chars and YouTube's hard cap is 100.
script_fix: endcard-treat.sh had The Chain's values hardcoded (EXPECT=299.0, FADE_START=295.152, audio probes at t=240/280/295) — all past the end of a 230s song, so it refused to run. Now derives FADE_DUR from the card's measured duration, FADE_START from video length minus that, and scales probe points to 0.80/0.94/0.985 of the song. --expect is optional and keeps the strict truncation gate when given.
gotcha: First cut of that fix used `for t in $PROBES` — the script is zsh, which does NOT word-split an unquoted scalar, so it iterated once over the whole string and falsely reported a silent tail. Now an array. Failing closed was correct behaviour; if this error appears on a file you trust, check the splitting before hunting in Resolve.
outstanding: Dean uploads to YouTube by hand (332 MB+ exceeds the 10 MB browser-upload cap). Insert the videos row only AFTER the video is public — a private/scheduled id renders a broken embed: duration_seconds 231, video_type 'video', band_id jumbo-band-brisbane-2026.
